title: [Security] Month 1 SCA/PCI release checklist for Stabilize work
body:
## Why
Cross-cutting for all six months: every release ships with its own SCA/PCI review — especially payments and identity flows touched by Phase 1.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Checklist covering KYC capture/upload, auth changes, chat (PII in transcripts), analytics (no sensitive data leakage)
- Threat notes for document images and verification status APIs
- Sign-off required before Month 1 RC

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checklist published in repo/docs and linked from each Month 1 feature PR template
- [ ] At least one completed review artifact for the Month 1 RC
- [ ] Open findings tracked with severity and owners

## Labels
Security · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Instrumentation] Baseline funnel analytics for Phase 1 exit metrics
body:
## Why
Needed to prove Phase 1 impact before Phase 2 investment. Watch **app-store rating** and **KYC time-to-approve** weekly; regression supersedes new feature work.

## Scope (Month 1)
Instrument and dashboard:
1. Onboarding drop-off by step
2. KYC time-to-approve (submit → approve/reject) + time-in-stage
3. Support ticket volume by category (incl. stuck transfer, KYC, login)
4. Auth failure rate and Android crash-free sessions (support Reliability issues)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Events defined, documented, and shipping in a release
- [ ] Dashboards live for the three primary Phase 1 funnels
- [ ] Weekly review ritual assigned (owner + channel)
- [ ] Alerting when KYC median TTA or rating trends regress

## Labels
Instrumentation · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Reliability] Stabilize Android app — crash and freeze triage
body:
## Why
Android crash/freeze reports are called out in store reviews and undermine trust while KYC/support fixes ship.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Pull crashlytics / Play Vitals: top crash clusters by version and OS
- Fix top crashers (ANRs, null refs, lifecycle, WebView/camera if tied to KYC)
- Establish crash-free sessions baseline and weekly gate for releases
- Smoke checklist for cold start, login, send money, KYC camera

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Top N crash clusters (agree N with eng lead; suggest top 5) addressed or mitigated
- [ ] Crash-free sessions baseline documented; no regression on release candidates
- [ ] Known freeze paths (esp. KYC camera / transfer confirm) retested on target devices

## Labels
Reliability · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Reliability] Fix cross-border login and account-linking bugs
body:
## Why
Explicitly called out in AU/EU Play Store reviews — login and account-linking failures block sending and amplify support volume.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Reproduce and catalog top login/account-linking failure modes (region switch, multi-device, SSO, phone/email mismatch)
- Fix P0/P1 defects; add regression tests for affected auth paths
- Improve error messaging (recoverable vs contact-support)
- Add structured logging / funnel events for auth failures (no PII in cleartext)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] P0/P1 known login/account-linking bugs fixed or have documented workarounds with owners
- [ ] Auth failure rate dashboard exists and is reviewed weekly
- [ ] Regression coverage for fixed paths
- [ ] Security review for any auth-flow changes

## Labels
Reliability · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Support] Self-serve `why is my transfer delayed` diagnostic flow
body:
## Why
Many delay inquiries are repetitive (compliance hold, payout partner hours, incorrect receiver details). A guided self-serve flow deflects tickets and sets accurate expectations.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Design diagnostic tree from transfer status + known delay reason codes
- Implement in-app flow: select transfer → explain likely cause → next actions (wait window, edit details if allowed, contact support)
- Deep-link to live chat only when self-serve cannot resolve
- Cover top corridors / reason codes first; expand later

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] User can open the flow from transfer tracking without leaving the app
- [ ] Top reason codes produce plain-language explanations and next steps
- [ ] Escalation to chat/ticket preserves diagnostic context
- [ ] Deflection rate (flow completed without ticket) measurable

## Labels
Support · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Support] Restore/expand in-app live chat for stuck transfers
body:
## Why
Reviews repeatedly cite loss of human agents as a top frustration when transfers are stuck.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Inventory current chat entry points and where they were removed/gated
- Restore live chat for **stuck transfer** contexts (transaction detail, error states, tracking screen)
- Ensure chat transcript includes transfer MTCN / reference and corridor context
- Define hours, queue, and fallback (callback / ticket) when agents offline
- Log chat open → connect → resolution for instrumentation

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] From a delayed/stuck transfer screen, user can start live chat in ≤2 taps
- [ ] Agent sees transfer context without asking the user to re-type the reference
- [ ] Offline hours show clear fallback and expected response time
- [ ] Chat volume and connect success rate tracked

## Labels
Support · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [KYC] Add visible in-app verification status tracker
body:
## Why
Customers report weeks of silence during verification. A visible status tracker reduces support load and perceived delay even when backend review is still in progress.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Define status model: Submitted → In review → Action needed → Approved / Rejected
- Build tracker UI on account/home and deep-link from KYC completion
- Surface **Action needed** with clear next steps (re-upload docs, selfie, etc.)
- Push/in-app notification hooks for status transitions (wire events; delivery can harden in Month 2)
- Map statuses to analytics events for time-in-stage

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] User can see current verification stage without contacting support
- [ ] Action-needed state shows concrete remediation steps
- [ ] Status updates within agreed freshness SLA (document assumed API latency)
- [ ] Events emitted for each stage transition

## Labels
Trust & onboarding · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [KYC] Improve document-scanning UX for identity verification
body:
## Why
#1 complaint across Play Store / Trustpilot — KYC delays of weeks were reported. Better capture quality reduces resubmits and manual review.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Audit current document-capture flow (camera permissions, framing guidance, blur/glare detection, retake UX)
- Ship clearer on-screen guidance (document edges, lighting, hold-steady cues)
- Add client-side quality checks before upload (blur, crop, glare, incomplete page)
- Reduce dead-ends: actionable error copy + one-tap retake
- Instrument capture → upload → submit success/fail rates

## Out of scope (Month 2+)
Full backend approval SLA redesign; new ID types beyond current corridors.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Capture guidance and quality checks available in the primary KYC path
- [ ] Resubmit rate for document quality reasons measurable and trending down vs baseline
- [ ] No increase in crash rate on camera/KYC screens
- [ ] SCA/compliance review completed for the release

## Labels
Trust & onboarding · Phase 1 · Month 1

title: [Epic] Month 1 — Stabilize foundations (KYC, support, reliability, analytics)
body:
## Context
From the 6-month roadmap (**Phase 1 — Stabilize**, Months 1–2): stop the bleeding on the most-cited complaints before adding anything new.

**Guiding logic:** Fix what is losing customers today before investing in what could win new ones tomorrow.

## Month 1 objective
Stand up the foundations and first shippable increments for all four Phase 1 workstreams so Month 2 can harden and hit exit metrics.

## Child workstreams
- Trust & onboarding (KYC)
- Support
- Reliability
- Instrumentation

## Phase 1 exit metrics (target by end of Month 2)
- KYC median approval time cut by **50%**
- App-store rating trend **flat-to-up** while fixes ship

## Cross-cutting
Every release ships with its own SCA/PCI review, especially anything touching payments or identity.

## Acceptance
- [ ] All Month 1 issues under this milestone are Done or explicitly deferred with rationale
- [ ] Baseline dashboards live for onboarding drop-off, KYC time-to-approve, and support ticket volume by category
- [ ] At least one KYC UX improvement and verification-status MVP in a release candidate
- [ ] Live chat path restored for stuck-transfer cases (or clear interim escalation path)
- [ ] Top login/account-linking and Android crash defects triaged with fixes for P0/P1
